url.title: Target Website URL
url.description: The URL of the website you want to automate (e.g. https://books.toscrape.com)

taskDescription.title: Task Description
taskDescription.description: Describe in plain English what data to extract or steps to perform.
taskDescription.default: Extract books and prices with availability

workflowId.title: Saved Workflow ID (Optional - For Fast Replay)
workflowId.description: If provided, skips discovery and replays the saved workflow graph with new parameters.

inputValues.title: Input Parameters (Optional)
inputValues.description: Key-value map for runtime parameter substitution (e.g. {"query": "travel"}).
